queries_run: Amazon.com 10-K customer concentration no single customer 10% revenue AWS backlog OpenAI Anthropic concentration 2026

findings.claim: Q1 2026 財報電話會議：管理層稱 AWS backlog 分布均衡，未集中於一兩家客戶
findings.source: Amazon Q1 Earnings Call Transcript: Backlog Evenly Distributed Across Multiple Clients (iTiger)
findings.excerpt: Andy Jassy: Regarding the backlog, it stood at $364 billion in Q1, excluding the recently announced multi-hundred-billion-dollar agreement with Anthropic. The backlog is well-balanced and not concentrated with just one or two clients;

customer_concentration_credit.note: 未讀到10-K原文確認10%門檻；搜尋摘要僅見管理層稱AWS backlog分散、未集中於一兩家客戶，第三方估計Anthropic/OpenAI為backlog主要增量（非公司揭露）。零售端客戶為終端消費者。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
